original_test_intent: Collect and reconcile the full FRU and presence inventory for every expected node and chassis-level component in the target Oberon chassis.
original_method: Authenticate read-only to the verified BMC, preserve complete unfiltered FRU and SDR outputs, parse record identities structurally and compare them to an owner-approved chassis/node/component manifest, reporting every missing, duplicate, unreadable or unexpected entry.
manual_activity: No routine physical action is required. The inventory owner supplies the authoritative Oberon node/FRU manifest and reviews only discrepancies or ambiguous mappings.
required_inputs: Exact Oberon chassis serial/asset and verified BMC endpoint/certificate/host identity
Expected node count, node IDs/slots and chassis component hierarchy
Expected FRU IDs, product/board/serial fields and allowed empty/placeholder rules
SDR entity/sensor-to-node presence mapping and firmware-dependent exceptions
ipmitool version/transport compatibility and secure secret provider
Raw evidence retention, sensitive serial redaction and structural comparison policy
safety_requirements: Use only read-only FRU/SDR commands against the verified target
Never place credentials in process arguments/logs or disable endpoint verification
Preserve unfiltered raw outputs; do not use grep as the authoritative dataset
Fail closed on wrong target, transport truncation, parser error or ambiguous record-to-node mapping
Do not write FRU, change sensor thresholds, reset/power the chassis or clear logs
No automatic retry that could conceal intermittent BMC/transport errors
agent_execution_scope: Verify BMC/chassis identity and approved expected manifest
Execute secure read-only full FRU and SDR collection
Parse FRU areas and SDR/entity records while retaining raw bytes/text
Reconcile every expected node/component and flag extras/duplicates/errors
Perform no mutation, inferred repair, retry or PASS/FAIL verdict
engineer_actions: Approve expected chassis/node/FRU/SDR manifest and exception policy
Resolve ambiguous FRU/entity mapping or allowed empty fields
Review discrepancies and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `fru print` is directly relevant, but command-line password flags and grep-filtered SDR output are unsafe/incomplete for whole-chassis completeness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect complete `ipmitool fru print` and unfiltered `ipmitool sdr list` through protected credentials, then perform structural reconciliation against the approved Oberon manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Every node, complete Oberon chassis inventory, ipmitool basis and 60/60-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: FULLY AUTOMATABLE READ-ONLY OBERON INVENTORY RECONCILIATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Normalize FRU/SDR records into a hierarchy keyed by node/slot/entity plus stable identity fields, hash raw sources and compare to the approved expected manifest with explicit discrepancy classes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure target verification, full unfiltered evidence, structural mapping and sensitive-data handling without changing the read-only purpose.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A grep hit shows only matching text and cannot prove absent records, completeness or node identity. Raw plus decoded FRU/SDR and the expected manifest are required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: FRU IDs and SDR entity instances may be firmware-dependent and are not automatically equivalent to physical node numbering. The mapping must be approved so duplicate or missing nodes are not hidden by generic chassis-level records.

project_override_considerations: Firmware-specific optional FRUs or placeholder fields may be allowlisted only by exact platform/revision and remain visible in evidence; they must not be silently ignored by the parser.
expected_evidence: Verified chassis/BMC/firmware/ipmitool identity and approved expected manifest
Complete raw unfiltered `fru print` and `sdr list` with timestamps and hashes
Decoded per-node/component FRU fields, SDR presence mapping and parser diagnostics

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure, Criteria and DeepSeek agree on read-only FRU/SDR inventory of the whole chassis. Filtering and missing expected-manifest details are evidence/readiness weaknesses rather than contradictory semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The collection is read-only and automatable. The owner-approved expected manifest is needed for completeness acceptance but does not prevent static review or safe collection.

review_improvement: Preserves FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification while replacing grep-only, plaintext-secret collection with full structural reconciliation and traceable discrepancy reporting.
independent_technical_reasoning: Inventory completeness cannot be inferred from the presence of any FRU-like SDR line: a chassis-level record can exist while one node is absent, and firmware may emit multiple records for one component. The validator must reconcile a cardinality-and-identity manifest, not just search strings. Retaining raw data also allows mapping rules to be audited without recollecting or mutating the BMC.
